IS 12203 : 2025 Multipurpose Grease for Automotive Applications - Specification
ICS 75.100
ICS 75.100
PCD 25
PCD 25
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and method of sampling and test for multipurpose grease suitable for applications on all automotive vehicles and also as wheel bearing grease operating at temperatures ranging from - 20 °C to 120 °C.
1.2 This standard also covers grease containing molybdenum disulphide additive.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
